data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Experience, then Baggage allowance, then select cabin class) with the right cabin_class parameter, and only adds an open-site step and a read step; it loses a point on feasibility because the cabin class control is described as a "tab" with a few example values, and the "Before you fly" section label is an unverified detail.
